voiceover: Is the universe fine-tuned for life? The fundamental constants of physics — the force of gravity, the balance of the forces, the expansion rate of the cosmos — sit inside an astonishingly narrow range that permits life. Move any of those dials a hair's width, and there are no stars, no planets, no chemistry, no us. This isn't fringe science. Even atheist physicists concede the data. The dials really are set with breathtaking precision. A cosmos balanced this finely for life points beyond itself — to a Mind that meant for us to be here. As the psalmist wrote, long before the physics: the heavens declare the glory of God.
